blocks.html: Designed for Singapore’s Hot, Humid Climate— Ideal for Dull, Dehydrated, or Reactive Skin

This results-driven yet soothing facial is specially formulated to thrive in Singapore’s tropical weather. It delivers deep hydration, brightens dull skin, and calms sensitivity—all in a featherlight formula that won’t clog pores or cause irritation.

At the heart of the treatment is our exclusive Power Dose Brightening Ampoule, a potent blend of Glutathione, multi-molecular Hyaluronic Acid, and skin-repairing peptides.

Together, these high-performance ingredients work to restore radiance, replenish moisture, and smooth the skin. If your skin feels dry or sensitive, looks dull, or gets easily congested in humidity, this facial was designed with you in mind.

blocks.html: FAQs

items.q: How soon will I see results from the Power Dose Facial?
items.a: You can expect visible results instantly. Many clients notice a brighter, more even skin tone immediately after the treatment. For best results, we recommend taking a before-and-after photo to track the improvement.

items.q: Is the Power Dose Facial suitable for sensitive skin?
items.a: Yes, the facial is safe for all skin types, including sensitive skin. We use only gentle, high-quality actives, ensuring a maximum impact with minimal irritation. No harsh ingredients or heat-based tools are involved.

items.q: Why is this facial specifically designed for Singapore’s climate?
items.a: The formulation is lightweight, which allows optimal absorption of the active ingredients in this humid climate. Our Power Dose Brightening Facial is crafted with Singapore’s tropical climate in mind, focusing on balancing hydration, calming redness, and tackling sun-induced pigmentation. It’s based on 22 years of skincare expertise and client feedback from the region, ensuring the treatment meets the specific needs of local skin.

items.q: What makes this facial different from other brightening treatments?
items.a: Unlike typical brightening treatments, this facial avoids harsh peeling and chemicals. It uses gentle ingredients that are synergistically blended to offer brightening.

items.q: How long will the results last?
items.a: While immediate results are visible, maintaining bright, healthy skin requires ongoing care. We recommend regular treatments and sun protection to prevent further pigmentation from UV exposure.

items.q: Can I do this facial if I have acne or other skin concerns?
items.a: Yes, this facial is gentle enough for acne-prone and reactive skin. It’s designed to calm inflammation while providing deep hydration, making it suitable for a wide range of skin conditions, including sensitive and acne-prone skin.

items.q: How often should I book this facial?
items.a: For lasting brightness and a balanced complexion, we recommend a series of treatments, spaced 2-4 weeks apart, depending on your skin’s needs. Regular facials will help maintain a clear and glowing complexion.
